'''Silla'''<ref name="DB" /> was a temperate [[forest]]ed [[planet]] in [[the galaxy]]. Featuring forests, [[grass]]lands, and [[mountain]]s,<ref name="Metamorphosis" /> Silla was a slow-paced and serene world. Its inhabitants lived in smaller villages spread across the grasslands.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Starship|vessel]] [[transport 904]] crash-landed on the planet, and its cargo, a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]] [[Specimen A|specimen]], escaped. The rogue [[clone trooper]]s of [[Clone Force 99]], unaware of the ship's cargo, arrived on Silla and attempted to scavenge it, but discovered the creature and eventually fled. The citizens of a [[Unidentified village (Zillo Beast)|nearby village]] would be rounded up and whisked away as the beast went on a rampage.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />
